utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you start by sorting the donations and setting aside anything electrical? I’ll swing by later and help with the pickup list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donations and set aside anything electrical. I’ll have the pickup list ready for when you swing by.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a screwdriver and a couple spare screws? Also, can you check whether the loose panel is the one near the back?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a screwdriver and a couple spare screws, and I’ll check the back panel too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep tabs on the supplies for the repair drive—what do you need me to check?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Cleo — could you check what supplies we still need and let me know if anything’s running low?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ll check what we’ve got and flag anything that’s running low. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet—what kind of repairs are we helping with?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet, but I’d want to know the schedule and what tools or supplies they need before agreeing to anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. I’ll ask for the schedule and a list of tools or supplies, then let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell — are we still on for the repair drive, and what time should I bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I think so — I’m just waiting on the latest update. If you can bring the tools around 10, that should work.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll bring the tools around 10. Can you text me if anything changes with the update?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting some good traction—folks are dropping off all sorts of useful stuff. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Tess—thanks for keeping me in the loop. If you need any tools for the drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Gus—thanks. I’ll let you know if I need anything, and I’ll pass along any fresh news about the drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'm spreading the word now. If Opal can make it, the repair drive will be a lot smoother with a few extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can make it—I’ll be there to help. Just let me know where to meet and when.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—thank you, Opal! Meet me at my place at 9 AM, and we’ll head over together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Kira — what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what kind of help you mean, Sam?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with organizing, lifting, or picking up supplies—whatever would be most useful for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re kicking off the repair drive, Bo. I’ve got a simple list ready, and we can start with the homes that need help most.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—keep it simple and I’ll help where I can. Let’s start with the highest-need homes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll sort the list by need and share the first few homes with you right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the repair drive plan to everyone nearby so they know what’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. That’ll help keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll make sure everyone hears the repair drive plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help if you need me to bring anything or lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. If you could just help me sort the tools and carry a few boxes, that would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Uli — I can do that. Just point me to the tools and boxes, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’d start with Mrs. Patel on Birch Street and then Tom over by the corner store—both were asking about it last week.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll reach out to Mrs. Patel first, then Tom by the corner store.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—if you’re free, come by and bring anyone who might need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Quinn—I’ll try to swing by later and I’ll mention it to a couple neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Dane! I appreciate it—see you later, and feel free to send folks my way if they need anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive — what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Could you bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and a roll of duct tape? If you’ve got a flashlight too, that’d be very helpful.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can bring those, and I’ll grab a flashlight too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time works best for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — late Saturday morning would work best for me. If that fits the school schedule, I can help get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late Saturday morning should work on my end; I’ll check the school schedule and confirm. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what’s the biggest thing we still need to sort out?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We still need to pin down the repair list and who’s bringing the tools. I’ll repeat the plan around to folks once we’ve got that sorted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I can help narrow down the repair list and match tools to each task. Want me to draft a quick checklist you can send around?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over a drill and a wrench set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot — could you let me know what time you’re bringing them over? I’m trying to keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by around 4 o’clock, if that works for you. I’ll drop them off at the front table so they’re easy to grab.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where everything’s going for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Opal—thank you. I’ll make a neat list of the items so we can stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—I’ll note each location as you go and keep the list tidy.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, what time should I drop off the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the exact drop-off time window first? I want to make sure I have the details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can drop it off between 3 and 4 PM. Would that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you bring any spare screwdrivers, duct tape, and a few extension cords? If you’ve got time, I could also use help setting everything out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can bring those and help set everything out, too. I’ll swing by with what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting pretty busy—do you know what they still need? I can pass it along to folks if you do.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not totally sure, sorry — I think they still need a few more volunteers and maybe some tools. If you hear specifics, pass them along and I’ll do the same.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I will. I’ll keep asking around and let you know if I hear what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — I heard they’re keeping it going this week. I’ll pass along any new updates if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — can you confirm the time and where to drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to hear the repair drive is moving along. Let me know if you need me to swing by and drop anything off.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I might take you up on that if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — just text me if you need anything picked up or dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm in if you need a hand. Just remind me what time and where we’re meeting, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — we’re meeting at the community center at 3 PM. I’ll send the exact spot if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks Leo — community center at 3 PM works for me. I’ll be there and ready to help.
